messages:
mira: Quick sync — Enterprise wants a short POC: streaming SDK -> function-calls for enrichment -> newline-delimited JSON lines to their on‑prem ingest. They also require customer-managed KMS/HSM attestations and SOC2 excerpts before pilot. Any blockers?

alex: SDKs (node/python/go) support streaming + function_calls. Main infra snag: their reverse proxy strips Authorization headers unless we do mTLS or provide ephemeral signed URLs.

judy: Cost note: they said ~15 qps, ~120 token input / ~600 token output. Streaming long outputs + function-calls will increase token usage; recommend reserved capacity estimate + 20% burst. I can post three pricing scenarios by EOD.

prashant: For strict newline JSON use structured-output + runtime schema validation. Recommended prompt suffix: "Return exactly one JSON object per line with keys id(string), verdict(string), score(number), meta(object). No extra text." Enable strict_mode to reject nonconforming items.

sec-bot: SOC2 Type II available. KMS: we support customer-managed keys (KMIP/AWS/Azure) for Private; HSM attestation depends on vendor but we can accept vendor-signed attestations or federate. Cert rotation: runtime certs rotate daily; customer cert cadence configurable. Compliance ticket: INC-8201. ETA 48h for initial bundle.

mira: Action items: Judy — post pricing scenarios; Alex — scope mTLS vs ephemeral URL effort; Sec-bot — assemble minimal compliance packet; I'll schedule kickoff for next Tue (agenda: SDK demo, KMS workshop, proxy cert exchange).

alex: mTLS path estimate: 2-3 eng days + customer coord; ephemeral signed URL: ~1 day eng + docs. I'll prepare a cert-exchange checklist.

judy: Posting pricing by 17:30 PST with on-demand, 6mo reserved, 12mo reserved options and a note about quantized model tradeoffs for cost.

prashant: Minimal Node SDK snippet to share:
```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'rwd-stream-1', stream: true, function_calls: true });
stream.send({ content: 'Process items and return newline-delimited JSON with id,verdict,score,meta' });
stream.on('data', chunk => console.log(chunk));
```

mira: Thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll coordinate with procurement once the packet and pricing are in.
